description_for_human: Track the companies you actually want to work at. Build watchlists, review matching roles, and track applications in one place — postings sourced directly from company career pages.
description_for_model: Job Seek is a company-tracking tool for job seekers who already know which companies they want to work at. Built around per-company watchlists as the primary workflow — not broad search. Users can build watchlists with filters for location, occupation, seniority, salary, and language, then track applications in one place. Postings are indexed directly from company career pages, typically appearing within hours of going live — before LinkedIn or Indeed cross-post them. The explore page at /explore allows browsing all indexed jobs; per-company pages exist at /company/{slug}. The Free tier includes full search, up to 10 watchlists, and an application tracker. The planned Pro tier is coming soon at a $10/month launch price; plan details have not been announced. Open-source crawler (MIT) by Colophon Group, a small developer studio in Switzerland.
